strictJson.method: Python json.loads over data/catelog, data/markets, data/history, data/schemas, data/evidence with object_pairs_hook rejecting duplicate keys and parse_constant rejecting NaN/Infinity (guide section 7.11.1).

jsonSchema.reason: No installed Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema validator (no Python jsonschema module, no Node ajv) and no dependency was installed without authorization.

supplementaryCheck.method: Manual field-by-field conformance script written directly against the text of rolex-market.schema.json and rolex-price-history.schema.json: verified exact top-level key sets (additionalProperties:false equivalent), required fields, marketCode/modelReference/currencyCode regex patterns, enum values for priceType/listingStatus, taxRatePercent range, listed-price integer/non-negative rule, null price for non-listed statuses, source/alias/nickname object shapes, and URI validity, for the new GB market and history files, plus re-verified the catalog's structural invariants after the sourceMarketCodes edit.

crossFileConsistency.method: The guide's Node.js cross-file invariant script (section 7.11.2), run unmodified against this repo's data/catelog, data/markets, data/history paths.

sourceReconciliation.method: Programmatic reconciliation of all 1,465 evidence observations against data/markets/rolex-united-kingdom-market.json (modelName, caseDescription, dialDescription, isNewModel, productUrl) and data/history/GB/rolex-price-history.json (currency, last listed price). 0 mismatches in either direction; 0 market watches or price-history series were orphaned from the evidence observations or from the catalog.

websiteCompleteness.notes: Stop condition was the structured endpoint itself: a single request with numberOfResults=2000 (exceeding the true total) returned results.length === totalCount === 1465, independently corroborated by a second request with numberOfResults=500 that reported the same fixed totalCount=1465 (showing totalCount does not vary with the requested page size). Full click-through UI pagination to 1,465 was not separately re-walked; instead 19 individual official product pages (17 collection representatives + both members of 2 same-base-model pairs) were independently fetched from the live browser session as raw rendered HTML and reconciled 1:1 against the structured dataset with 0 mismatches (see independentSpotChecks below). Additionally, the full 1,465 GB modelReference set was diffed against the pre-existing 1,465-entry cross-market catalog: 0 references in GB only, 0 references in the catalog only — an exact set match, consistent with every prior market's terminal collection.

changeSafety.method: Enumerated every JSON file under data/ before and after this run; confirmed byte-for-byte content for all files this task did not intend to touch, and confirmed the only intentional change (catalog sourceMarketCodes) altered nothing else in that file.

intentionallyChangedFiles.data/catelog/rolex-catalog.json: sourceMarketCodes gained 'GB' (now [JP, TW, DE, US, AT, GB]); watches array (1465 entries, byte-for-byte identical structure and content), watchCount (1465), and collectedAt (2026-08-31T21:17:28+08:00) are unchanged because every GB modelReference already existed in the catalog (0 new configurations). File grew by exactly 1 line (10270 -> 10271) matching the single new array element.

nicknameResearch.notes: PASS with 5 accepted local nicknames (the guide's stated maximum) and 1 accepted collection-wide alias. Official Rolex collection/family names (e.g. 'Cosmograph Daytona', 'GMT-Master II', 'Day-Date') were not themselves treated as nicknames. Candidates were accepted only when at least one UK-market source (a London-headquartered or .co.uk-domain retailer/publication) was found, and where two same-base-reference configurations existed in the catalog, only accepted when a source (including, for Batman/Batgirl, Rolex's own official GB product pages) could distinguish which specific configuration the name applies to.

independentSpotChecks.method: 17 official product pages (one per collection, matching the GB structured dataset's family list, using the same representative modelReference set as the AT/DE/US runs for direct cross-market comparability) plus both members of 2 same-base-model configuration pairs were fetched as same-origin fetch() calls from inside the live chrome-devtools MCP browser session (reading raw rendered HTML, not the JSON API used to build the structured dataset) and checked for the presence of the exact modelReference and the exact GBP price string from the structured watchgrid response.
independentSpotChecks.notes: 19 unique product pages were fetched (unlike AT/DE/US's 21-check convention, GB's 17 representatives already include both members of the day-date and sky-dweller pairs, so totalChecks equals the 19 unique pages actually fetched with no double-count). All 19 returned HTTP 200, contained the exact modelReference string, and displayed exactly the expected GBP price string with no other price string variants on the page. This reconciliation additionally served as the source for the m126710blnr-0002/0003 bracelet-type (Jubilee vs Oyster) confirmation used in nicknameResearch above.

limitations: JSON Schema validation is NOT RUN because no Draft 2020-12 validator (Python jsonschema, Node ajv) is installed and no dependency was installed without authorization; a manual field-by-field conformance check (documented above) was performed as a supplementary, non-substitute check and found 0 errors.

Full click-by-click UI pagination to a rendered count of 1,465 was not separately re-walked for GB; the structured endpoint's own totalCount === results.length terminal signal (cross-checked at two different page sizes) was used as the primary completeness proof, further cross-checked by 19 independent official product-page fetches with 0 mismatches and by an exact 1,465-to-1,465 set match against the pre-existing cross-market catalog.

The 'Sprite' / left-handed GMT-Master II nickname candidate was left unaccepted (not rejected on lack of evidence, but on inability to confirm handedness against the specific configuration codes present) rather than accepted on an unverified assumption; see nicknameResearch.rejectedCandidates.
The repository's existing catalog directory is data/catelog/, not the guide's example catalog/ path; this predates this task and was not changed.
